module origen_195921 (
    input clk,
    input miso,
    input measure_start,
    output reg sck,
    output reg cs,
    output reg [15:0] data_out,
    output reg enable
);

    reg [9:0] count;
    reg [2:0] countsck;
    reg [4:0] countdatai;
    reg [4:0] i;
    reg [15:0] datain;
    reg flag, flag_d;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (measure_start) begin
            flag <= 1;
        end

        if (flag) begin
            if (count < 100) begin
                cs <= 0;
                sck <= 1;
                count <= count + 1;
            end else if (countsck < 4) begin
                sck <= ~sck;
                countsck <= countsck + 1;
                if (countsck == 3) begin
                    flag_d <= 1;
                end
            end else if (i < 16) begin
                sck <= 0;
                datain[i] <= miso;
                i <= i + 1;
            end else if (i == 16) begin
                sck <= 1;
                i <= i + 1;
            end else begin
                cs <= 1;
                data_out <= datain;
                enable <= 1;
                flag <= 0;
                count <= 0;
                countsck <= 0;
                countdatai <= 0;
                i <= 0;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
